turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: A bit sore, but okay lah. My tummy is achy, but not too bad.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Can you rate your pain on a scale from 0 to 10 for me?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Maybe a 4? It’s manageable, but I can feel it when I move.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Any nausea or vomiting since waking up? Sometimes anesthesia can cause that.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, no vomiting. Just a bit of dizziness when I sat up earlier, but it went off.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. How’s your breathing? Any tightness or discomfort in your chest or throat?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Throat’s a bit sore from the tube, but I can breathe fine. No wheezing or anything.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Do you remember anything about the surgery itself? Sometimes patients have fuzzy memories.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Nope, everything’s blank from when I went to sleep. Woke up here, so all good.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: You have a history of hypertension and allergies. Any issues with those today?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Blood pressure’s been fine, no headaches. Allergies? Nose is clear, no sneezing.
